# The operational interface (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, "The operational interface").
# Regenerate with `make operational-interface-fixture`; never edit by hand.

healthz /healthz 200 "ok"
readyz /readyz state=starting stopped=false connected=false 503 "starting"
readyz /readyz state=starting stopped=false connected=true 503 "starting"
readyz /readyz state=starting stopped=true connected=false 503 "draining"
readyz /readyz state=starting stopped=true connected=true 503 "draining"
readyz /readyz state=serving stopped=false connected=false 503 "nats disconnected"
readyz /readyz state=serving stopped=false connected=true 200 "ready"
readyz /readyz state=serving stopped=true connected=false 503 "draining"
readyz /readyz state=serving stopped=true connected=true 503 "draining"

exit 0 "the broker stopped as asked: a shutdown signal, at any phase after its handlers are registered, and the shutdown or the startup's unwinding returned; also `-h`. Not a promise that every buffered publication reached NATS: the service connection's close is bounded"
exit 1 "the broker could not start, or the embedded NATS server stopped it: `fatal: <reason>` on stderr, except the embedded server's own fatal error, which is an `ERROR` record with `component: nats-server`. A startup step that does not observe a signal (the NATS dial, the first service-identity request, both bounded) reports its own failure here"
exit fatal-prefix "fatal: "

envelope time "RFC 3339 with fractional seconds, in the host's time zone (UTC in the published images)"
envelope level "`DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARN` or `ERROR`"
envelope msg "the record's message; frozen only for the records below"
envelope component "`nats-server` on the embedded NATS server's records, absent otherwise"

kind string "a JSON string"
kind integer "a JSON number"
kind boolean "a JSON boolean"
kind duration "a JSON number of nanoseconds"
kind time "an RFC 3339 JSON string"
kind text "a JSON string; its wording is not part of the interface"

record "starting mqtt-nats-broker" level=INFO
  field version string
  when "once, first"
record "health server listening" level=INFO
  field addr string
  when "once, when the health port is bound"
record "health server error" level=ERROR
  field err text
  when "when the health server stops serving other than at shutdown"
record "profiler listening" level=INFO
  field addr string
  when "once, with `-pprof-addr`"
record "profiler listener could not bind" level=ERROR
  field addr string
  field err text
  when "once, with `-pprof-addr`; the broker starts without the profiler"
record "profiler error" level=ERROR
  field err text
  when "when the profiler stops serving other than at shutdown"
record "embedded NATS server ready" level=INFO
  field server string
  field config string
  when "once, in the embedded topology"
record "waiting for JetStream" level=INFO
  field err text
  when "at most every 10 s while the embedded server's JetStream does not answer"
record "connected to NATS backend" level=INFO
  field urls string
  field in_process boolean
  field server string
  field server_version string
  field jetstream_api_level integer
  field cluster string
  field js_domain string
  when "once, when the service connection passed the NATS floor and JetStream answered"
record "MQTT initialization did not complete; retrying" level=WARN
  field attempt integer
  field err text
  when "at most every 10 s while the MQTT initialization is retried"
record "shutdown signal received during startup" level=INFO
  field err text
  when "once, when a shutdown signal ends startup before the broker served"
record "MQTT listener started" level=INFO
  field addr string
  field node string
  field tls boolean
  when "once, when the broker serves"
record "MQTT over WebSocket listener started" level=INFO
  field addr string
  field tls boolean
  when "once, with `-ws-port`"
record "shutdown signal received, draining" level=INFO
  when "once, at the first shutdown signal after the broker served"
record "draining, waiting for endpoint deregistration" level=INFO
  field delay duration
  when "once, with `-drain-delay`"
record "NATS service connection error" level=WARN
  field err text
  when "per asynchronous error the service connection reports"
record "MQTT: the service connection reconnected but could not be identified; no CONNECT is accepted" level=ERROR
  field err text
  when "per reconnect whose identity request fails; `/readyz` still answers `200 ready`"
record "MQTT: the service connection dropped while it was being re-identified; the account stays unknown" level=WARN
  when "per occurrence"
record "MQTT: the service connection reconnected into another account; disconnecting every auth-passthrough client" level=ERROR
  field account string
  field previous_account string
  when "per occurrence"
record "MQTT: refusing CONNECT: the service connection's account is not currently established" level=WARN
  when "per CONNECT refused for it"
record "MQTT: refusing CONNECT" level=WARN
  field client_id string
  field reason text
  when "per CONNECT whose identity cannot be established or is bound to another account"
record "MQTT TLS configuration reloaded" level=INFO
  field subject string
  field serial string
  field not_after time
  field generation integer
  when "per applied TLS reload"
record "MQTT TLS reload refused; keeping the active configuration" level=ERROR
  field err text
  when "once per run of identical refusals, not per attempt"
record "MQTT TLS certificate has expired and no valid replacement is on disk" level=WARN
  field subject string
  field serial string
  field not_after time
  when "once per served certificate, not repeated"
record "NATS service connection did not finish closing in time; closing it now" level=WARN
  field wait duration
  when "at most once, at shutdown"
record "NATS service connection closed" level=INFO
  when "once, at shutdown"
